name: Stratified-Rare-Disease-Benchmark-Cohort-n1047
alternateName: A Stratified Rare-Disease Benchmark Cohort for Literature-Based Causal Gene Prioritisation (n=1,047)
description: A deterministic, reproducible benchmark of 1,047 rare-disease cases for evaluating literature-based causal gene prioritization. Each case pairs a patient phenotype profile (Human Phenotype Ontology terms) with a 50-gene candidate list (1 causal + 49 randomly sampled distractor genes) and the true causal gene, sampled across four operational MONDO-derived disease strata (developmental, immunological, metabolic, neurological). Derived from the GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26 by a seeded, version-pinned pipeline so the cohort regenerates exactly from public inputs (RANDOM_SEED=42; per-case distractor seed = BLAKE2b(global_seed | case_id)). Ships two deconfounding sidecars: per-case annotation-overlap flags (whether a case's source publication is cited by phenotype.hpoa for the causal gene) and source publication dates (recency stratification). The annotation-overlap flag identifies the fair (overlap-absent) subset (cohort overlap rate approximately 73%, 765/1,047) recommended for unbiased comparison against curated tools.
citeAs: @dataset{angulo2026rd_cohort, author = {Angulo, Johanna}, title = {A Stratified Rare-Disease Benchmark Cohort for Literature-Based Causal Gene Prioritisation (n=1,047)}, year = {2026}, publisher = {Figshare}, version = {v1.0}, doi = {10.6084/m9.figshare.32814449}, note = {Derived from GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26; CC BY 4.0.}}
rai:dataCollection: Not primary data collection. The 1,047 cases are selected from the GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26 (published rare-disease case reports encoded as GA4GH Phenopackets) by a deterministic, version-pinned pipeline (methods/foundation release, stages 13-20). Inclusion requires at least 3 HPO terms, a single causal gene, and at least 5 PMC Open Access articles mentioning that gene; cases are disproportionately stratified across four MONDO-derived categories (250 developmental / 300 immunological / 250 metabolic / 247 neurological).
rai:dataCollectionType: Curated/derived benchmark: selection plus seeded synthetic distractor sampling over an existing open dataset. Not a population sample and not primary clinical data.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels are inherited, not re-annotated: causal_gene, hpo_terms, and diseases are taken byte-for-byte from the source phenopacket. The 49 distractor genes per case are drawn from the HGNC protein-coding pool by a per-case deterministic seed (BLAKE2b(global_seed=42 | case_id)); the causal gene's ground-truth position is recorded in causal_gene_index_in_candidates.
rai:dataUseCases: Intended for benchmarking literature-based / retrieval-augmented causal gene prioritization and ranking systems. NOT intended for clinical decision-making, diagnosis, or as evidence about real patients.
rai:dataBiases: Annotation-overlap (leakage) bias: for approximately 73% of cases (765/1,047) the source publication is cited by HPO phenotype.hpoa for the causal gene, which can advantage curated tools. The annotation_overlap.json sidecar flags this per case; evaluate on the fair (overlap-absent) subset for unbiased comparison. The cohort over-samples immunological cases for subgroup statistical power, so the category mix is not epidemiologically representative.
rai:dataLimitations: One causal gene per case; distractors are protein-coding HGNC genes only (three neurological cases with non-protein-coding causal genes are excluded by construction, hence n=1,047 not 1,050). Because it is derived and seeded, it is a reproducible evaluation set rather than a sample of the disease population.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No direct identifiers. Content is limited to phenotype (HPO), disease (OMIM/MONDO), and gene (HGNC) terms plus a source-publication reference, all derived from already-published, openly licensed case reports in the GA4GH Phenopacket Store. No raw clinical records, images, or genomic sequence are included.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Versioned on Figshare under a persistent DOI (this item is v1.0). The cohort regenerates from pinned public inputs plus the methods/foundation code (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32814491); every file's SHA-256 is pinned in CHECKSUMS.sha256 and the build manifest.

distribution.name: test_cases.jsonl
distribution.description: Canonical cohort: one JSON object per case (1,047 rows).

distribution.name: annotation_overlap.json
distribution.description: Per-case annotation-overlap flags plus meta (cohort overlap rate). Deconfounding sidecar for the fair-subset evaluation.

distribution.name: pmid_dates.json
distribution.description: Source-publication dates per PMID plus meta. Recency-stratification sidecar.

distribution.name: test_cases_manifest.json
distribution.description: Build manifest: pinned versions, seed, category distribution, SHA-256 and byte size of test_cases.jsonl.

recordSet.name: cases
recordSet.description: One benchmark case per record. The prediction task is to rank candidate_genes so that causal_gene appears at the top; the ground-truth position is causal_gene_index_in_candidates.

field.name: category
field.description: Disease category: one of developmental | immunological | metabolic | neurological.

field.name: hpo_terms
field.description: Patient phenotype as Human Phenotype Ontology term IDs (HP:NNNNNNN); at least 3 per case.

field.name: diseases
field.description: Associated disease(s): a repeated record of {id, label}. id is typically an OMIM CURIE (OMIM:NNNNNN); label is the disease name.

field.name: causal_gene
field.description: HGNC symbol of the true causal gene (the prediction target).

field.name: candidate_genes
field.description: 50 HGNC symbols to rank: the causal gene plus 49 seeded random distractors.

field.name: causal_gene_index_in_candidates
field.description: 0-based index of causal_gene within candidate_genes (ground-truth label position).

field.name: pmc_article_count
field.description: Number of PMC Open Access articles mentioning the causal gene (coverage; at least 5 by construction).

field.name: source_phenopacket
field.description: Relative path to the source phenopacket JSON within GA4GH Phenopacket Store v0.1.26.
